coder-enrage-armed-npc.head: 6d543c9e1f057e90642c1ec32e011fa95a1ab0d2
coder-enrage-armed-npc.scope: Stock selected wounded Blackwood. 27 IS, two-second cast, 28-second own reuse, 12-second state 93 and no HP damage. One close-combat seek to the nearby helper. The fight persisted two rounds past Enraged removal without opening combat against the caster and ended on ordinary helper withdrawal.

coder-engage-foes-enrage-area.head: 8f4ac0c3
coder-engage-foes-enrage-area.scope: Selected Primary. Two exact in-radius NPC recipients, 50 IS, 2 s cast, 30 s reuse, six-second state and matching most-hated entries. Identical runtime rebased as 7b28d00d.

588.note: PR866 verifies the NPC GenericEnrageUpdate consumer, the exact lifetime and ordinary dismissal of the existing fight. The remaining player controls are the EnrageInit interlock target-change and IS Block restrictions in tempmods.py. The existing player withdrawal gate is tested. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/866#issuecomment-7088184673

targeting.source: GOB 588 uses CastDirectObjects 0, CastValidTarget 3, SelectionRange 16, CastWhenUsed 1, and TestFunction 2. GenericEnrageUpdate excludes players and occupied NPCs before seeking an enemy in sight within 1000 units.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler holds the original hostile selection through cast completion; AbilityTargets tests viral deflection before the selected recipient gets state 93. MobAggro.EnragePulse separately searches eligible enemies in sight and opens close combat for an idle NPC only.
targeting.test: PR850 and PR866 land on the selected NPC. PR866 observes one NPC seek to the nearby helper and no second engagement against CSR. EnrageNpcUpdatesTests covers expiry and death guards; AbilityRefusalFeedbackTests.DelayedHostileCastCannotLandOnANewerSpawnInTheOriginalView and FreeCastViralLandingTests.ActualNpcLandingDeflectsBeforeDamageDebuffAndProcAndOnlyRoutesToVisibleSameWorld cover the 588 stale selection and deflection paths. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/850#issuecomment-7087168434 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/866#issuecomment-7088184673

controls.source: GOB 610 stores Enraged state 93 for six seconds.
controls.runtime: AbilityHostile applies one standard Enraged record to each admitted NPC and expires the linked record normally.
controls.test: Stock PR850 saw the two six-second adds and removals, with no records on excluded targets. ActualLandedRecipientGetsOneOwnerAndNoDamage verifies the ordinary landing. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/850#issuecomment-7087168434

area.source: EngageFoes_DirectObject enumerates hostile NPC recipients in an inclusive six-metre radius around the selected NPC.
area.runtime: AbilityHandler and AbilityEngageFoes retain selected target identity and treat additional eligible NPC recipients independently.
area.test: Native PR850 hit the selected Primary and exact Edge only, excluding Outside at 6.01 m and Near CSR. SecondaryRecipientHasAnIndependentDeathAndViewWitness checks live view and target gating. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/850#issuecomment-7087168434

script.source: The shipped EngageFoes_DirectObject calls the Enraged effect, and TauntAggro requests most-hated ownership on accepted NPCs.
script.runtime: AbilityEngageFoes calls the existing taunt map only after a successful 610 recipient effect with live caster and recipient witnesses.
script.test: Only610UsesItsStoredInitializerAndExistingEnrage, UncompletedOrCancelledCastHasNoInitializer and the live engage-foes-taunt scenario cover acceptance and exclusions. The stock run saw two most-hated entries and ordinary NPC counter-engagement. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/850#issuecomment-7087168434

behavior-tests.source: GOB 610 defines the selected area, 2 s cast, 50 IS, 30 s reuse and six-second Enraged with zero direct damage.
behavior-tests.runtime: Ordinary cast handling, AbilityHostile and AbilityEngageFoes preserve independent resource, boundary, expiry and NPC threat behavior.
behavior-tests.test: EngageFoesTests, the disposable NAV fixture and the live engage-foes-taunt scenario, plus the stock cast and exact boundary/expiry observation. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/850#issuecomment-7087168434
